original.target_description: Original source located; page 17 contains ANOVA/t tests, not a uniquely identified Pearson correlation; broad description also fits several section 3.3 correlations.

notes: Source title and DOI match the original reference. The supplied description names a family of stress/asymmetry/cortisol analyses, without specifying the critical electrode pair, phase, outcome index, or test contrast. No target chosen from audit ID, input order, or numeric matching. Explicit final analysis sample candidate: N=21 male participants, following exclusion of N=2 for premature CPT termination and N=1 for excessive movement artifacts (Methods 2.1, PDF p.8). Methods 2.9 (PDF p.13) explicitly calls N=21 the final sample size for the RFA repeated-measures analysis. This is a printed final N, not an N derived from df or a sum. Retained only as a candidate because exact row/test correspondence is unresolved; participant count is distinct from EEG epochs excluded for artifacts. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders only. Requested r is not printed in the page-17 RFA ANOVA/pairwise section; do not convert its t/F/eta-squared values to r. A page offset cannot be assumed. PDF p.17, section 3.2 contains multiple tests: omnibus LOCATION F[1,20]=7.88, p=.011; CONDITION*TIME F[1,20]=5.38, p=.031; CONDITION*LOCATION F[1,20]=7.88, p=.011; TIME*LOCATION F[1,20]=4.80, p=.041; three-way interaction F[1,20]=3.57, p=.073; CONDITION*TIME at F7/F8 F[1,20]=5.25, p=.033 and F3/F4 F[1,20]=3.39, p=.080; intervention stress/control contrast F7/F8 t[20]=2.67, p=.015 and F3/F4 t[20]=1.17, p=.256. These are distinct same-test candidate pairs, all p values printed as equality, not bounds. No selection justified by broad description. PDF p.20, Table 2 has 8 outcome rows and 10 asymmetry columns (Average Pre, Pre, During, Post, During-Pre at F3/F4 and F7/F8). Cortisol AUCg candidate r/p pairs, in that explicitly printed column sequence: -.546/.010, -.157/.496, -.512/.018, -.324/.152, -.364/.104, -.203/.377, -.385/.085, -.342/.129, -.248/.278, -.099/.670. Cortisol AUCi is a separate index; cardiovascular and subjective outcomes are also tabulated. None is uniquely identified by locator p.20. Section 3.3 (PDF pp.18-19) distinguishes same-day baseline cortisol r as printed ". -.512" with p=.018 from average-baseline r=-.546 with p=.010. No typo correction or metric conversion performed. Candidate final-sample evidence: Due to premature termination of the CPT (N=2) and excessive movement artifacts (N=1), three ... subjects needed to be excluded from final analysis, resulting in a total number of 21 ... participants (mean age: 26.5, range: 22-32 years). Critical analysis sample evidence: analysis conducted with G*Power (Faul et al., 2007) on the final sample size (N=21) showed Candidate test evidence: correlation with cortisol only reached significance during baseline (r = . -.512, p = .018).
